objective: Model Improvement Experiments: Ensemble Blending, Seasonal Calibration & Site-Baseline Adjustment

peer_cohort.validation_transfer: Does not transfer to summer validation because ElasticNet underprediction bias degrades ExtraTrees' superior summer centering

full_cohort.validation_transfer: Maintains robust performance (Val MAE 1.3625 improves over Pure ElasticNet 1.3765)

experiment_2_astronomical_calibration.reason: Astronomical features are already present in primary model inputs; post-hoc residual calibration produces negligible gain (<0.0001) on tree models and increases error on linear models due to collinear overfitting

experiment_3_site_bias_adjustment.reason: Shrunk trailing site bias yields negligible CV reduction (-0.0012) while introducing operational state complexity and risk of drift during seasonal ramp-up

peer_cohort.justification: While 50/50 blend achieved lowest training CV RMSE (1.2715), ExtraTrees demonstrates far superior performance on the seasonal validation split (RMSE 1.3462 vs 1.4635) and lower complexity

full_cohort.justification: Tuned ElasticNet provides un-saturating linear scaling on extreme Site 19 yields with minimal footprint (2.7 KB) and microsecond latency (350 us); 70/30 blend provides competitive fallback (Val MAE 1.3625)
